utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can put something in, but I need to keep it modest right now. Just let me know where it’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli — that helps a lot. I’ll point you to the spot that needs it most and keep it modest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you’re heading over, I’d bring a little extra tape or a sturdy box if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, nice — I missed that it was already moving along. I’ll see if I’ve got some tape or a box around here.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what’s the repair drive collecting this time?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the usual stuff—tools, spare parts, and anything folks can fix up and reuse.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what part of the repair drive needs the most help right now?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Glad you made it, Dane — we need the most help sorting donations and matching them to the right repairs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over my tool kit for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need fixed first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so you can bring the tool kit over, yeah? What exactly are we fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a rough count on the supplies, Oren—just tell me what the repair drive needs most and I’ll check what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo—what we need most is screws, strong tape, and any spare wire you’ve got. I’m a bit scattered, but I can sort through it with you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Ira — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mara — could you help spread the word and collect a few donations? I’m making a list of what the repair drive still needs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s still on for Saturday morning, and we’ve got the basics covered. I’m just trying to confirm a few volunteers and tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where everything’s going for the repair drive. Just tell me the locations, and I’ll note them down.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be a big help, Opal. I’ll list the locations one by one so it stays nice and tidy.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — could you bring a few sturdy boxes and tape, and maybe help sort the tools when you get here?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details again, just so I make sure I have everything right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — it’s this Saturday from 9 to 12 at the community center parking lot. We’re collecting small appliances, bikes, and household items that need simple repairs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, perfect — I’ve been meaning to tell everyone about the repair drive. Want me to pass along an invite and get you the details?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please — that would be great. Thank you.
